text:
Welcome to the course. Over the next four lessons we are going to build what I call the trust funnel, and I want to be clear about what it is. The trust funnel is a sequence where every step exists only to earn the right to the next step. It is not a sales funnel. A sales funnel drives toward a transaction. The trust funnel drives toward a decision the supporter feels good about, which is why it converts better over time.

The three stages are attention page, first tip, and supporter loop. The attention page is where a stranger decides whether you are real. The first tip is where a follower becomes a supporter with a small amount of money. The supporter loop is where a supporter comes back, and that loop is where almost all of the revenue actually lives.

Here is the edge case almost everyone misses: if your page asks for money before it earns trust, every downstream metric looks fine until it suddenly does not. Conversion happens once and the loop never forms. So the first lesson is simple. Trust before ask. Every mechanic we build in this course is derived from that one principle.
